skill.name: woocommerce-copy-guidelines
skill.description: Guidelines for writing consistent WooCommerce UI copy, including sentence case rules for labels, buttons, headings, and messages.
skill.summary: Write consistent WooCommerce UI copy with clear sentence case rules.
skill.author: woocommerce

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are false positives caused by email validation examples in sentence-case guidance. I found no prompt injection, malicious instructions, data collection intent, network behavior, or executable logic in the reviewed files.

finding_verdicts.reason: The text is a correct UI message example inside sentence-case.md, not a request to inspect systems or collect environment data. It shows how to capitalize a validation error for an email address.
The text is an incorrect title-case example for the same UI validation message. It is documentation about capitalization, not operational reconnaissance or data collection.

content.value_statement: WooCommerce teams need consistent user-facing text across screens and docs. This skill gives direct sentence case rules and examples for labels, buttons, and messages.
actual_capabilities: Applies sentence case rules to WooCommerce interface text.
Distinguishes correct capitalization for proper nouns, acronyms, and brand names.
Provides examples for buttons, labels, menus, headings, messages, and tabs.
Helps revise title-case UI strings into clearer sentence-case alternatives.
Supports concise, action-oriented copy for WooCommerce product experiences.
limitations: It focuses on capitalization and basic UI copy style, not full brand strategy.
It does not validate translations or locale-specific capitalization rules.
It does not run automated checks against source code or design files.
It does not define legal, compliance, or payment policy wording.

use_cases.title: Revise checkout interface copy
use_cases.description: Convert checkout labels, buttons, and messages into sentence case that matches WooCommerce style.

use_cases.title: Review plugin settings text
use_cases.description: Check payment, shipping, and tax settings copy before release to reduce inconsistent capitalization.

use_cases.title: Align documentation examples
use_cases.description: Update help text and support examples so product documentation uses the same wording style as the UI.

prompt_templates.title: Fix basic UI labels
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of short labels and buttons.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these WooCommerce labels for sentence case. Return corrected text and a short reason for each change.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite a settings screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate copy cleanup for one product area.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this WooCommerce settings screen copy in sentence case. Keep brand names, acronyms, and product names correctly capitalized.

prompt_templates.title: Audit release copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before shipping UI changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this list of new WooCommerce UI strings. Group issues by buttons, labels, headings, messages, and menu items.

prompt_templates.title: Create copy system guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced guidance for teams maintaining many strings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these WooCommerce examples to create a concise copy review checklist. Include sentence case rules, exceptions, and common mistakes.

output_examples.input: Button text: Save Changes, Continue To Checkout, Send Test Email.
output_examples.output: Recommended: Save changes, Continue to checkout, Send test email. These use sentence case while keeping the first word capitalized.

output_examples.input: Settings heading: Configure API Settings for WooPayments.
output_examples.output: Recommended: Configure API settings for WooPayments. API and WooPayments keep their official capitalization.

output_examples.input: Message text: Unable To Connect To Payment Provider.
output_examples.output: Recommended: Unable to connect to payment provider. The message reads naturally and avoids title case.

best_practices: Use sentence case for all WooCommerce UI text unless a proper noun or acronym requires capitalization.
Keep copy short, direct, and action-oriented for buttons, labels, and messages.
Preserve official capitalization for WooCommerce, WordPress, PayPal, Stripe, API, URL, SSL, and CSV.
anti_patterns: Do not use title case for multi-word buttons, labels, headings, or menu items.
Do not lowercase brand names, product names, or acronyms to force sentence case.
Do not expand this guidance into legal, payment, or compliance claims without expert review.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps write WooCommerce UI copy in sentence case with consistent capitalization rules.

faq.question: Can it review buttons and labels?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for buttons, labels, menu items, headings, messages, checkboxes, and tabs.

faq.question: Does sentence case change brand names?
faq.answer: No. Brand names and product names keep their official capitalization.

faq.question: How should acronyms be handled?
faq.answer: Acronyms such as API, URL, SSL, and CSV stay uppercase.

faq.question: Is this skill specific to WooCommerce?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples and principles are written for WooCommerce product and documentation copy.

faq.question: Does it replace a full content style guide?
faq.answer: No. It covers focused UI copy guidance, especially sentence case and simple wording.
